Home.headline: One system from work order to invoice.
Home.subhead: Work orders, plan approval, hours, inventory, and invoicing in one system — so you run the floor, not the paperwork.
Home.bayTitle: Jobs the way the shop runs — digital.
Home.baySub: Plate, work, and status at a glance. No whiteboard. No sticky notes.
Home.step1Body: Create a work order with lines (services or checklist). Status: draft — no shop-floor work yet.
Home.step2Body: Send the work plan. Digital approval with a typed signature in the portal — required before the floor starts.
Home.step3Body: After approval: assign a technician, log hours, mark done. Then optionally create a PDF invoice.
Home.portalBody: Customers approve work plans in the portal — and later see status, inspections, and invoices.
Home.portalImageAlt: Technician working in a garage workshop
Home.rolesSub: Everyone works in one system — with exactly the tools their role needs.
Home.roleBackBody: Customers, inspections, timesheets, and invoices — no Excel islands.
Home.roleTechBody: Assigned work orders after approval: timer or manual hours, inspections on the floor.
Home.roleCustBody: Approve work plans with a signature, follow status, download invoices.
Home.finalCtaBody: Book a short demo. We’ll show how GarageApp fits your flow.

Features.title: Everything the shop needs
Features.intro: Back office, technician, and customer portal — one work order from draft to invoice.
Features.storyTitle: The Golf is outside. Brakes squeal.
Features.storyIntro: Not a feature tour. The real flow: work order → work plan → portal approval → then the floor → invoice.
Features.beat1Body: Open a work order, add services and materials — from your stock or as an order. No technician yet, no timer — the plan comes first.
Features.beat2Body: Send for approval. The customer opens the link, types a signature, and approves — shop floor stays locked until then.
Features.beat3Body: Approved? Then assign a technician. Timer or manual hours — back office reviews timesheets later.
Features.beat4Body: After done, build an invoice from approved hours and materials (stock or order). PDF ready — the customer gets it in the portal.
Features.asideTitle: Inspection and inventory — beside the flow.
Features.asideBody: Not every job starts with an inspection. You can keep stock: products, quantities, and materials that deduct from the work order.
Features.inspectionBody: Optional. Configurable checklists, per-item status, draft and finalized reports — only when the job asks for it.
Features.planBody: Send for approval. Customer signs digitally in the portal — required before execution.
Features.woBody: From draft to done: lines, work plan, approval, assignment, and hours.
Features.timeBody: Timer or manual entry, after approval. Back office approves or rejects timesheets.
Features.invoiceBody: Draft → sent → paid. PDF from approved hours and materials.
Features.portalBody: Approve work plans, follow status, inspections and invoices — via magic link.
Features.draftLine3: Not sent to the customer yet
Features.inventoryBody: Keep parts and products for your shop. On the work order: from stock or as an order — stock deducts when the work plan is approved.

Pricing.title: Clear pricing. No surprises.
Pricing.intro: Pick a plan. Start with a demo. Pay monthly or yearly (2 months free).
Pricing.starterBody: For one small shop ready to leave Excel behind.
Pricing.proBody: For most shops — full flow from job to invoice.
Pricing.businessBody: For multi-location shops and small chains.
Pricing.finePrint: Prices excl. VAT. Setup beyond included onboarding by agreement. 14-day money-back after your subscription starts.
Pricing.enterpriseLink: More than 5 locations? Ask about Enterprise →
Pricing.included1Body: New features without separate upgrade fees.
Pricing.included2Body: Email support on business days, NL/EN.
Pricing.included4Body: Role-based access: tech, back office, admin.
Pricing.faq1A: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades take effect at the end of your billing period.
Pricing.faq2A: Monthly or yearly by invoice (iDEAL / bank transfer). Yearly = 10× the monthly price.
Pricing.faq3A: Monthly: cancel up to 14 days before renewal. Yearly: runs to the end of the term.
Pricing.faq4A: GarageApp is a web app. Stable shop internet is recommended.

About.title: Built for repair shops
About.intro: GarageApp is an Innovolabs product — made to replace legacy Excel/Access workflows without disrupting the floor.
About.storyBody: A technician must see their work order and log hours. The back office must turn that into an invoice — without re-entry. Every design choice starts there.
About.value1: Dutch-first — UI and processes for the local market.
About.value2: One source of truth — inspection through invoice linked.
About.value3: Customer transparency — status without phone ping-pong.
